summary: The diff modifies the three PDF export utility files (pioneersPdfExport.ts, tasksPdfExport.ts, notesPdfExport.ts) with styled HTML content and print window approach. However, the implementation uses window.open() with a print window rather than a programmatic file download mechanism, and the page files (Pioneers.tsx, Tasks.tsx, Notes.tsx) do not appear to have been modified to add Export to PDF buttons.

missing_requirements.requirement: On the existing Pioneers.tsx page, ensure there is an 'Export to PDF' button positioned in the top-right action area next to the existing 'Export to CSV' and 'Add Pioneer' buttons.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff does not show any changes to frontend/src/pages/Pioneers.tsx. No Export to PDF button was added to the Pioneers page.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement the actual file download mechanism so that clicking Export to PDF initiates a file download with the correct filename without requiring the user to manually rename it from a print dialog.
missing_requirements.reason: All three utilities use window.open() and openPrintWindow() which opens a browser print dialog. This does not automatically download a file named 'pioneers-report.pdf', 'tasks-report.pdf', or 'notes-report.pdf'. No jsPDF or blob-based anchor download mechanism is implemented.

missing_requirements.reason: The pioneersPdfExport.ts still uses the openPrintWindow approach, which does not produce a file named 'pioneers-report.pdf' automatically downloaded.
